purpose: Contract for merging QuestForge task systems with the command battle prototype.

hp.description: Player health. Existing QuestForge HP can be reused.

mp.description: Battle resource earned from task completion and spent on commands.

focus.description: Temporary bonus from streaks, daily completion, or Toggl Track focus sessions.

payload.classId: sentinel | archivist | operator | alchemist | ranger | artificer

mergePlan: Add mp and focus to QuestForge character state.
Change task scoring from direct boss damage to MP gain.
Move boss damage into battle command handlers.
Keep old auto-attack as an optional setting for users who prefer Habitica-style flow.
Use this prototype as the battle view mounted under the existing Boss page.
